cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'll carry your book bag to the platform. My shoulder should manage one more staircase. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it. There are dictionaries in there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. No, keep your hands free for the tickets. I'll change shoulders at the bottom.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've moved our train to platform twelve, across the bridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, lead the way. I'll give each shoulder a staircase and rest my fingers while you find our seats.

mechanism: A manages a station journey while graciously carrying a worsening burden, accepting B route control and making each physical cost audible.
confusable: Unlike refusing help simply to dominate, A keeps offering accommodations while displaying the inconvenience; confidence survives by yielding practical navigation.
comparison: Travel, dictionaries and shoulder fatigue differ from a host waiting while guests eat.
seedUse: Use canonical D45-b book bag/tickets/platform bridge chain and S02-b adapting role division to keep the partnership cooperative.
